mods.name: Effect Master
mods.description: Control how status effects behave on players. Any effect, including ones added by other mods, can be disabled, left at vanilla behaviour, or kept applied permanently. The settings are shared across the world and only the server owner can change them.

releases.notes:
Added
- Read-only mode for the config screen
- A mod logo, shown in the mods list
- English and Japanese translations — the screen used to show raw translation keys

Changed
- The server is now the only holder of the settings; the client sends back only what changed when the screen closes
- Persistent effects use infinite duration, keep their HUD icon, no particles
- The effect list is sorted by display name
- Only effects changed from vanilla are written to the config file
